title: Prepared Startup Equals Its Canonical Call
statement: Let $B$ and $F$ be Boolean finite Turing machines, let $a$ be a state of $B$, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, and let $f$ be any configuration of $F$ on input $x$. The prepared startup configuration formed from $f$ equals the startup call on the initial configuration of $B$, with release clear, no flag, counter word equal to the output of $f$, and fuel configuration $f$.
replaced:
For every halted fuel configuration $f$, the prepared startup configuration of the loop
host equals the startup body call built on the body's initial configuration with release
clear, no flag, counter word the output of $f$, and fuel residue $f$.
